rows.label: tlk70000067_02_msg0001
rows.name:
It sounds noisy outside. Have bandits
shown up again?

rows.label: tlk70000067_02_msg0002
rows.name:
They're some nasty folk. Quite a
few times I've had to give shelter
to people fleeing them...

rows.label: tlk70000067_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Bandits seem to want Core Crystals.
Maybe they're selling them on the
black market. What a sorry state...

rows.label: tlk70000067_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I reckon they'll get caught
before too long now that
Shin's here in Iira!
